title: Juicy Peppery Squid Stir-fry
description: A kid-friendly Korean dish featuring tender baby squid stir-fried with a tangy and spicy glaze, perfect for quick weekday dinners.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sliced onions and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute until fragrant.
Add baby squid and stir-fry for about 2-3 minutes or until just cooked through.
Pour in soy sauce, fish sauce, gochujang, and mirin. Stir well to combine.
Reduce heat to low and let the mixture simmer for about 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld together.
Sprinkle sesame seeds evenly over the top and cook for another minute until heated through.
Garnish with chopped green onions before serving.
